fields.description: Master kill-switch. Turn off to stop location tracking for all employees instantly, without a mobile app release.
fields.label: Enable Location Tracking

fields.description: Number of points bundled into each upload/insert call from the device. Higher = less server load but less "live" data; lower = more real-time but more requests.
fields.label: Batch Size

fields.description: Minimum time (ms) between points while in balanced (low-power) mode.
fields.label: Time Interval (ms)

fields.description: Minimum distance (metres) the employee must move before a new point is captured in balanced mode.
fields.label: Distance Interval (metres)

fields.description: Minimum time (ms) between points while in high-accuracy (traveling) mode.
fields.label: Time Interval (ms)

fields.description: Minimum distance (metres) the employee must move before a new point is captured in high-accuracy mode.
fields.label: Distance Interval (metres)

fields.description: Speed (metres/second) above which tracking switches from Balanced to High Accuracy mode. Tune per region (e.g. commuting field staff vs. on-site staff).
fields.label: Traveling Speed Threshold (m/s)

fields.description: GPS fixes with a reported accuracy worse than this value (metres) are discarded as noise. Loosen in areas with poor GPS coverage, tighten elsewhere.
fields.label: Min Accuracy Threshold (metres)

fields.description: Lower-priority knobs — safe defaults, tune less often.
fields.label: Advanced (Queueing & Retry)

fields.description: Maximum time (ms) a point can sit locally before being force-sent even if the batch isn't full yet.
fields.label: Flush Interval (ms)

fields.description: Minimum time (ms) to remain in a tracking mode before switching again, to avoid rapid oscillation between Balanced and High Accuracy.
fields.label: Mode Switch Cooldown (ms)

fields.description: Maximum number of points to hold in local on-device storage while offline/during an outage, before oldest points are dropped.
fields.label: Max Local Queue Size

fields.description: Initial backoff delay (ms) before retrying a failed upload.
fields.label: Retry Base Delay (ms)

fields.description: Upper cap (ms) on the exponential backoff delay between retries.
fields.label: Retry Max Delay (ms)
